key.query: Does the severity of obstructive sleep apnea predict patients requiring high continuous positive airway pressure?

evidence.title: PubMed 25081584 [abstract]
evidence.cited_text: STUDY OBJECTIVE To determine if a high score (≥ 3) on the STOP-Bang screening questionnaire for obstructive sleep apnea (OSA) predicts whether obese patients are at high risk for OSA and increased risk of difficult airway.
